messages.subject: Re: legend does not plot
parts:
Here is a solution

library(dplyr)
base <- mydata %>%
  filter(type != "Balance") %>%
  mutate(
    value = ifelse(type == "Exports", value, -value)
  )
balance <- mydata %>%
  filter(type == "Balance")
ggplot(balance, aes(x = year, y = value)) +
  geom_bar(data = base, aes(fill = type), stat = "identity") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = type)) +
  geom_line(aes(colour = type)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Exports = "#D55E00", Imports = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Balance = "red")) +
